appointment/class-slots.lifecycle.spec.t: Creates a throwaway service and a class slot with capacity 2
Enrolls one synthetic client so spotsBooked becomes 1
Asserts classSlots/update with capacity 0 (below spotsBooked) is rejected with 400
Tears down slot (cancel, cascades enrollment) and service (isActive:false)
Creates a throwaway service and a class slot with capacity 5
Enrolls a synthetic client once (succeeds, returns appointmentId)
Asserts a second enrollment of the same clientUserId is rejected with 409 (CONFLICT: already enrolled)
